_note: Retrieval-only test set written by Claude for the overnight retrieval experiments (E03+). NOT the 15 answer-quality questions the brief asks Divyanshi to write himself. 'gold' = list of [paper, regex]; a retrieved chunk is relevant if it is from that paper and its text matches the regex (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalised). 'need' = 'any' (one relevant chunk is enough) or 'all' (cross-paper: needs a relevant chunk from every listed paper). 'type' tags what the question stresses.
